1.21.1.1.1.4: Fixes world creation crashing with very tall worldgen datapacks (JJThunder To The Max) and chunk saving failing next to C2ME.
1.21.1.1.1.3: Event hooks next to other mods: no conflicts and the speed-up back; entity sleep next to mods that inject into entities; the render cache learns fields that don't change the picture.
1.21.1.1.1.2: The settings screen works again (every switch was locked and shown OFF since 1.1.0).
1.21.1.1.1.1: Fixes a NeoForge server not starting next to mods that wrap NeoForge event posts (VerifyError in CommonHooks); EMF hook optional.
1.21.1.1.1.0: Works with Lithium, Radium, ModernFix, Iris, Embeddium and ImmediatelyFast without losing its gains; burning entities on the render workers; faster interpolated textures.
1.21.1.1.0.3: Works with Lithium, Moonrise, C2ME, ModernFix and Embeddium (they crashed with 1.0.2); water and glass in one draw (about 2x fps over water); water lit by light volumes.
1.21.1.1.0.2: A new settings screen with a live overview, presets and stats; shaderpack options screens; applying pack options without a break.
1.21.1.1.0.1: Shaderpacks prepared over frames (no freeze on a driver's first compile); the settings screen shows which flags switch which; the mod list's logo, links and update check.

1.20.1.1.1.4: Fixes world creation crashing with very tall worldgen datapacks and chunk saving failing next to C2ME.
1.20.1.1.1.3: The same as 1.21.1: event hooks next to other mods, entity sleep next to mods that inject into entities (Collections Of Optimizations), render cache field learning.
1.20.1.1.1.2: The settings screen works again (every switch was locked and shown OFF).
1.20.1.1.1.1: The same fixes as 1.21.1: event sites next to mods that wrap them; the EMF hook optional.
1.20.1.1.1.0: The first release for Minecraft 1.20.1 / Forge.
